HFR signs $3.55 million Tyler robot contract with Foley Tile

The three-year agreement charges by installed area while skilled workers handle cutting, edges, finishing and quality.

PR Newswire ↗22 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A contract for contractor expansion

Human Friendly Robotics announced a three-year, $3.55 million agreement with Foley Tile on October 22. Tyler robots will accompany installers in Arizona and beyond, aiming to let the Tucson crew take larger distant projects without depending as heavily on local recruitment.

Robots place tiles, installers retain skilled work

Tyler handles repetitive placement involving lifting, bending and kneeling. Installers retain cuts, edges, finishing and quality control. Pricing is per installed square foot without an equipment purchase, shifting the contractor’s model toward service-based delivery.

Pilot performance is company-reported

The release says Tyler and the crew at Puerto Rico’s Plaza Las Américas achieved eight times the stated human benchmark pace. It does not detail measurement methods or guarantee every site’s results. This Foley Tile agreement is distinct from the previously announced Flooring Concepts of NJ deal.
